title: The Deep-Core Breach - Update - Shops/Ambience/Music
author: Epyx911
selftext:
Have been using Suno to add music and ambience.  I love the Armenian duduk (flute) and have used it across all songs.  Since the last update I have added a town and shops. I'm and old GenX gamer so for me the roots go back to Wizardry and having a town above the dungeon. However, it's single player Roguelike in terms of gameplay so again Legend of Grimrock meets Single Player Wizardry meets Dungeon Crawl Stone Soup.

I have also added traps and range weapons which I will highlight in a future update when I have store transactions working.  I really want this to be the game I always wanted to play. It won't be for everyone which is kind of the point...its for me first and foremost but I hope others enjoy it when completed.
